heading: Is Hushpuppies gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Hushpuppies and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Hushpuppies are typically made with cornmeal, which is gluten-free, but they often contain wheat flour and may be fried in shared oil, posing a risk for cross-contamination. Care should be taken to ensure that all ingredients and preparation methods are gluten-free.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Hushpuppies can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
faq.answer: Ask about shared equipment, sauces, marinades, and whether the kitchen has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.
